trees.label: Ti8
trees.distanceEncoding: strict upper triangle, row-major i<j; little-endian float32; implicit zero diagonal; mirror to lower triangle

provenance.mappingConfidence: exact source mapping; segmentation release not frozen
provenance.coordinateFrame: Tony FANC native SWC export; no additional transform
provenance.completeness: all source SWC vertices retained; biological full-arbor completeness not independently verified

trees.label: Ti8 180°
trees.distanceEncoding: strict upper triangle, row-major i<j; little-endian float32; implicit zero diagonal; mirror to lower triangle

provenance.mappingConfidence: exact source mapping; segmentation release not frozen
provenance.coordinateFrame: Synthetic rotation in source native frame
provenance.completeness: all source SWC vertices retained; biological full-arbor completeness not independently verified
provenance.experiment: Synthetic 180-degree Z rotation of Ti8 about centroid

gw.solver: POT ot.gromov.gromov_wasserstein, conditional gradient, unregularized square_loss
gw.weighting: uniform mass per original SWC node
gw.distanceConvention: dGW = 0.5 * sqrt(objective); RMS structural distortion = sqrt(objective)
gw.units: native coordinate units (unverified); objective has squared units
gw.caveat: Rotation invariance gives an analytic exact distance of zero; numerical residual is roundoff.

method.adjacency: symmetric: Euclidean parent–child segment length; zero for nonedges and diagonal
method.distance: sum of segment lengths on the unique tree path; zero diagonal
method.matrixOrder: source SWC file row order; node IDs exported without relabeling
method.nodeReduction: none; all 202 source nodes retained in each tree

rotation.centerDefinition: arithmetic mean of all original node coordinates
rotation.method: Same uniform masses, tree distances, 12 feasible initializations, loss, solver, scaling and tolerances as Ti8/Ti9. No imposed node-ID correspondence.
rotation.interpretation: Rigid rotation preserves segment lengths and tree distances: exact GW is zero. Numeric residuals are floating-point roundoff. The reported transport is solver output, not an injected identity plan.
